name: cx-box-carry
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.
error: Task 1 was not accepted within 10 attempts. Last critic feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: `Response(box_fell, holding_box)` does not ensure you pick the box up again afterward. Since `holding_box` is a lasting condition, it is owed on every step it holds after a fall; if the box is picked up before the episode ends, this rule then requires it to still be held on the last step. The task asks for a pickup after each fall, not to keep carrying the box afterward. Use a rule that requires a pickup event after each `box_fell`.
